podcast.body: This song, released in 1981, became Squeeze's biggest hit. It features keyboardist Paul Carrack on lead vocals, who was only in the band for about a year. The track has been widely covered by artists like Sting and Joe Cocker, and has been used extensively in TV commercials for brands such as Heineken and Burger King, as well as in video games like Grand Theft Auto. "Squeeze and tempted from 1981 featuring Paul Carrack on vocals and Like we saw with Guns of Brixton from the clash it was the band's third voice on lead vocals"

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music
